contents.title: Ḥašā
contents.contents: Complete canonical Hours for the Holy Week: Vespers, Compline, Midnight, Lauds, Terce, Sext, None (ܪܡܫܐ، ܣܘܬܪܐ، ܠܠܝܐ، ܨܦܪܐ، ܬܠܬܫܥ̈ܝܢ، ܫܬܫܥ̈ܝܢ ܘܬܫܥܫܥ̈ܝܢ) for Monday, fol. 3v-52r; Tuesday, fol. 52r-95v; Wednesday, fol. 95v-142v; Thursday with the washing of feet (ܫܝܓܬܐ), fol. 142v-213v; Friday with the Good Friday service (ܣܓܕܬܐ), fol. 213v-293r and Saturday with rite of forgiveness (ܨܠܘܬܐ ܕܫܘܒܩܢܐ), fol. 293r-344v
